$comment: Single source of truth for vendored/adopted skill pools consumed by BOTH harness bridges: opencode/plugins/dotfiles-bridge.ts (OpenCode; skills+commands+agents) and omp/extensions/dotfiles-skills.ts (OMP; resources_discover skillPaths). Marketplace-installed pools do NOT belong here - Claude's installed_plugins.json is their source of truth and both harnesses ingest it natively. Fields: root = package root relative to the dotfiles dir (skills expected at <root>/skills); namespace = bridge namespace; skills=false = bridge skips skills (OpenCode loads them natively from ~/.claude/skills); omp=false = OMP skips this pool (it gets it via its own plugin install); ompSkillsDir = OMP scans this dir instead of <root>/skills (supports ~/ prefix; used for installer-curated subsets).
